name: Joshua Aaron Rotenberg
headline: People Operations Leader — Hiring, Onboarding & Team Building
summary: Operations and people leader with 15+ years building and running client-facing and internal teams, including 2 years directly managing an onboarding team of up to 20 and contributing to the hiring, onboarding, and training of new hires. Runs high-volume, multi-account CRM pipelines with strict segmentation and data-hygiene discipline, the same rigor a busy requisition load demands, and brings direct-response copywriting experience to candidate-facing messaging and job postings.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Run a full-time portfolio of concurrent client engagements independently, prioritizing and tracking multiple simultaneous workstreams without dropping detail or momentum.
Architect and implement CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot — contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and data-hygiene protocols that keep records accurate and current.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable across multiple systems, keeping records auditable across concurrent engagements.
Draft direct-response outreach copy and messaging sequences that get responses from a cold or passive audience.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Led onboarding and training for a diverse, high-volume partner network, driving rapid adoption of new tools and processes.
Developed scalable communication workflows and structured training sequences that reduced onboarding friction.
Onboarded and managed 15–20 partner accounts, retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.

experience.title: Sales Team Lead — Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Took on team lead responsibilities for the sales team alongside individual account management.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years — a team of 20, later a team of 8 — overseeing budgets, scope, and delivery for a high-value client portfolio.

Contributed to hiring, onboarding, and training of new hires, and developed training materials for tenured team members, as part of building a new business vertical from proof of concept to a profitable line (corroborated by direct manager's written recommendation).

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science — Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
